blockers: The local environment (venv, weights, repo clone) was removed 2026-07-12 to reclaim 14 GB and to retire the now-unused Python 3.10 install it depended on. This worker requires a rebuild (a fresh venv against Python 3.12, weights re-download) before it can run again; lifecycle demoted from 'research_ready' back to 'discovered' until that happens.
TripoSG is kept only as the native-Windows offline fallback for machines without a WSL2 geometry environment.

One RTX 5090 smoke candidate previously passed transport and mesh-health capture (see resources/qualifications/triposg-1.5b_windows_rtx5090.json); corpus-level quality qualification never happened because the observed candidate had 17 disconnected surface components and is not a production deformation body.
Inputs must contain a valid alpha mask; BRIA RMBG is intentionally excluded.
The flash DiSo extractor is disabled until a separately isolated compiler toolchain is qualified.
